evidence: The film properties were investigated using x-ray photoelectron spectroscopy, x-ray reflectivity, x-ray diffraction, ellipsometry, time-of-flight secondary ion mass spectrometry, and x-ray absorption spectroscopy. In situ QCM measurements were performed to investigate the ALD mechanism. Complementary information regarding the surface species was obtained from in situ FTIR spectroscopy measurements. The thickness and refractive index of the ALD films were determined from spectroscopic ellipsometry (SE) measurements. XRR measurements were performed using a Bruker D8 instrument. XPS measurements were carried out on a Thermo Scientific K-Alpha+ spectrometer. A Hitachi S-4700 field emission scanning electron microscope (SEM) was used. Capacitance-voltage (C-V) measurements were performed on the as-deposited HfO2 films using Au/HfO2/Si structures.
